claims: Olivier Rioux is a 7-foot-9 (236 cm) center for the Florida Gators.
Olivier Rioux is the tallest college basketball player in NCAA history.
Olivier Rioux is a Canadian freshman.
Olivier Rioux gained recognition as the world's tallest teenager.
Olivier Rioux previously played for Canada's national team in FIBA events.
Olivier Rioux joined the Gators for the 2025–26 season.
Olivier Rioux made his debut in the 2026 NCAA Tournament.
Olivier Rioux broke the record as the tallest player to ever appear in an NCAA Tournament game, as shown in reports by The New York Times.
